OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: 1 if at least one input is 1

EXCLUSIVE_OR.NAME: Exclusive or
EXCLUSIVE_OR.DESCRIPTION: Logical exclusive OR of the inputs

BINARY_DECODER.NAME: Binary decoder
BINARY_DECODER.DESCRIPTION: Converts a value to single bits

OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: True value if I1 = I2, otherwise the false value

RS_FLIPFLOP.NAME: RS flip-flop
RS_FLIPFLOP.DESCRIPTION: Set/reset memory, reset wins when S and R are 1

SR_FLIPFLOP.NAME: SR flip-flop
SR_FLIPFLOP.DESCRIPTION: Set/reset memory, set wins when S and R are 1

PUSH_SWITCH.NAME: Push switch
PUSH_SWITCH.DESCRIPTION: Impulse relay: every pulse on T toggles the output

EDGE_DETECTION.NAME: Edge detection
EDGE_DETECTION.DESCRIPTION: Sends a pulse when the input changes from 0 to 1 or from 1 to 0

RISING.DESCRIPTION: Pulse on a change from 0 to 1

FALLING.DESCRIPTION: Pulse on a change from 1 to 0

MULTIPLEXER.NAME: Multiplexer
MULTIPLEXER.DESCRIPTION: Passes the input selected by S to the output

SELECT.DESCRIPTION: Number of the input to pass on (1-4)

OFF.DESCRIPTION: 1 resets the outputs and locks the block until Off is 0 again

SEQUENCER.NAME: Sequencer
SEQUENCER.DESCRIPTION: Every pulse switches on the next output, after the last one it starts again at O1

TRIGGER.DESCRIPTION: Pulse switches on the next output

POSITION.DESCRIPTION: Number of the output to switch on (0 = all off)

RESET.DESCRIPTION: Pulse switches on the default output

SELECTED.DESCRIPTION: Number of the selected output (0 = none)

MAX.NAME: Outputs used
MAX.DESCRIPTION: Number of outputs the sequence runs through (1-8)

DEFAULT.NAME: Default output
DEFAULT.DESCRIPTION: Output switched on by R (0 = all off)

SHIFT_REGISTER.NAME: Shift register
SHIFT_REGISTER.DESCRIPTION: Delays digital values by a number of pulses: every pulse stores D and shifts the register

TRIGGER.DESCRIPTION: Pulse stores D and shifts the register

DATA.DESCRIPTION: Value stored with the next pulse

DIRECTION.DESCRIPTION: 0 = shift up (enter at bit 1), 1 = shift down (enter at bit 64)

OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: Value of the selected register bit

RADIO_BUTTONS.NAME: Radio buttons
RADIO_BUTTONS.DESCRIPTION: Up to 16 outputs of which only one is on at a time, selectable in the visualisation

INPUT.DESCRIPTION: Pulse switches on the output with the same number

NEXT.DESCRIPTION: Pulse switches on the next output

PREVIOUS.DESCRIPTION: Pulse switches on the previous output

SELECT.DESCRIPTION: Number of the output to switch on (0 = all off)

DISABLE.DESCRIPTION: 1 ignores all inputs except the visualisation (child lock, cleaning)

VISU.DESCRIPTION: Selection from the visualisation, not limited by Max and DisPc

NUMBER.DESCRIPTION: Number of the active output (0 = all off)

MAX.NAME: Max. outputs
MAX.DESCRIPTION: Outputs that can be selected through the inputs (1-16)

LABELS.NAME: Output names
LABELS.DESCRIPTION: Names of the outputs for the visualisation, separated by ; (e.g. Off;Radio;TV)
